entry.author: NZ Defence Force
entry.summary:
Following a lengthy maintenance period, frigate HMNZS Te Mana and the ship’s company underwent an intense evaluation (known as a work-up) in preparation for upcoming deployments.
 
Every aspect of ship performance, and the sailors’ ability to operate it, was hard tested around the clock with a high level of scrutiny.
 
With approval to go, Te Mana is now on its way, with HNMZS Aotearoa, to Pearl Harbour in Hawaii for Exercise RIMPAC.
